user.title: Cantabile
user.description: Adds the Cantabile radio & cassette deck card (custom:cantabile-card) and the services it needs. Speakers, stations and the music folder are set on the card itself (⚙).

data_description.llm_api: Lets LLM-based conversation agents (Gemini, OpenAI, Claude…) start music and radio. Turn on “Cantabile” in the agent's options as well.
Lets LLM-based conversation agents start music and radio. Turn on “Cantabile” in the agent's options as well.
data_description.duck_sources: Assist satellites (e.g. Voice PE: while listening, thinking or answering) and media players (while they say a TTS message). The playing Sonos / WiiM speakers are turned down meanwhile.
data_description.duck_level: Percentage of the original volume; 0 = muted.
data_description.spotify_client_id: From developer.spotify.com → Dashboard → Create app. Enables catalogue search on the SPOTIFY tab. Not needed if the Home Assistant Spotify integration is set up (that also shows your own playlists). Playback: on Sonos with Spotify linked in the Sonos app, or on Spotify Connect speakers via the Spotify integration (Premium).
data_description.tidal_client_id: From developer.tidal.com → Dashboard → Create app. Enables catalogue search on the TIDAL tab; playback on Sonos with Tidal linked in the Sonos app.
data_description.tv_players: TVs that become Cantabile speakers with the track on screen. Cast devices (e.g. a TV stick) get the full TV page – equalizer / waveform, artist image, track details and progress (needs the “cantabile-tv” dashboard with a “tv” view holding the Cantabile TV card, see README). DLNA TVs (DLNA Digital Media Renderer integration) show a still track card: cover, artist image and details.

play.name: Play by name
play.description: Finds an artist, album, track, radio station or playlist by name and starts it on a Cantabile speaker. Returns what is playing and where.

query.name: What
query.description: Name of the artist, album, track, station or playlist.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: What the name refers to; automatic when unsure.

artist.name: Artist
artist.description: Artist of the album or track, if known.

speaker.name: Speaker
speaker.description: Speaker name from the card, or “all” for every Sonos speaker together. Empty: the one playing now, otherwise the first.

shuffle.name: Shuffle
shuffle.description: Random order. On by default for an artist.

play_tracks.name: Play tracks one after another
play_tracks.description: For players without a queue (e.g. WiiM): plays the tracks in order, repeating by the repeat rounds; stops when something else starts playing.

tracks.name: Tracks
tracks.description: List of media-source IDs or URLs, in order.

start.name: Start at
start.description: Index of the first track (0 = first).

stop_tracks.name: Stop track sequence
stop_tracks.description: Stops the track sequence started by “Play tracks one after another”.

sleep_timer.name: Sleep timer
sleep_timer.description: Stops the player after the given minutes (fading out during the last 30 seconds). Sonos uses its own timer. 0 clears the timer.

move_queue_item.name: Move track in queue
move_queue_item.description: Moves a track within the Sonos queue (positions start at 0).

set_order.name: Reorder track sequence
set_order.description: New order for the running “Play tracks one after another” sequence; it continues after the current track.

tracks.name: Tracks
tracks.description: The same tracks in the new order.

add_tracks.name: Add tracks to sequence
add_tracks.description: Appends tracks to the running “Play tracks one after another” sequence.
